verdicts.evidence: The directory listing collects data into ld3; failure substitutes a fixed string rather than enabling or disabling a behaviour (f1:33–37). Both outcomes flow into the same payload construction and unconditional POST (f1:38–40), so this is collection error handling rather than an environment gate.

The try/except assigns either the directory listing or a fallback string to ld3 and then rejoins the same execution path (f1:33–38). It does not decide whether exfiltration runs: the POST follows both outcomes without another condition (f1:40).
